title: sysstats v1

runable.$comment: Spelling comes from the SRS and production agrees. Format is runnable/total ("2/152").

temp.$comment: Millidegrees Celsius (62269 = 62.3 C). OPTIONAL: absent on gateways without a temperature sensor - one of the three production records omits it along with rtt, wan_if and rebootcause.

timespan.$comment: A STRING here ("300") but an INTEGER in lorastats, omsstats and netstats (1800, 3600). The same concept is encoded differently per type on the wire; do not assume one column type across types (ADR-003).

$comment: Re-derived from the 29 Aug 2026 production sample (ADR-007). The seven required fields were already correct and all three production records validate against them. The change is the OPTIONAL block: temp, rtt, wan_if, rebootcause and timespan are real production fields that were previously unmodelled, and they are optional because a gateway legitimately omits them - that is a device state, not a dialect disagreement, so it is corrected here rather than dead-lettered.
